files.docs/design.md:
# Design

## 1. Transport

The runner polls the server over outbound HTTP; no inbound port is needed.

## 2. Delivery

A turn is stored before it is delivered, and delivered at least once.
Delivery is idempotent on the turn's id.

### 2.1 Retries

A lost delivery is retried after the lease expires.

## 3. Recovery

Seq stays monotonic across respawn.
